description: Election Commission - Declare that D. M. A. Chandrerathna was Selected as the member of the Kevitiya of Panduwasnuwara Pradeshiya Sabha, - P. M. N. Rahuman was Selected as the member of the Musali P/S, - R. M.K.S. Ranaweera was Selected as the member of the Kurunegala P/S - A. P. P. N. Balasooriya was Selected as the memberr of the Mirigama P/S.
categorisation: This gazette contains multiple notices about filling vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content specifically deals with electoral processes - declaring selected members to fill vacancies caused by death, resignation, or failure to attend meetings. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it involves candidate nominations and declarations for local government positions under electoral legislation.
